title: Brain or Bias? Confound Control Removes Most of the Structural MRI Classification Signal for Autism in ABIDE I: analysis code and results
description: Analysis code, pre-specified analysis plan, result tables, figures and manuscript draft for a study of how much of the structural MRI (FreeSurfer v6 morphometry) signal for classifying autism in ABIDE I (N = 1,035; 17 institutions) survives adjustment for age, sex, head size, site, IQ, head motion and image quality. The ABIDE-derived data are under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 and are not covered by the code licence.
